name: Squilla Hero
description: Top-of-page hero. Last word of the headline gets an iridescent gradient (teal → violet → magenta → coral). Mantis-shrimp compound-eye motif on the right is rendered by JS based on the page-level data-motif attribute. Three CTAs: primary (filled), secondary (outline), tertiary (ghost).

field_schema.label: Eyebrow
field_schema.help: Small all-caps label above the headline. The design uses a colon-space-separated triple, e.g. 'AI-native · kernel-class · mantis-shrimp-fast'.

field_schema.label: Headline
field_schema.help: Big H1. The LAST WORD gets the gradient — write the headline so the most punchy word ends the sentence. The trailing punctuation (e.g. '.') stays glued to the gradient word.

field_schema.label: Lead paragraph
field_schema.help: 1–2 sentences under the headline. Wrap accent words in <span style="color: var(--accent)"> for the inline highlight.

field_schema.label: Primary CTA
field_schema.help: Filled button. The view prepends '$ ' and appends ' →' to the text.

field_schema.label: Secondary CTA
field_schema.help: Outline button. The view appends ' ↗' to the text.

field_schema.label: Tertiary CTA
field_schema.help: Ghost (borderless) link. Use copy like 'read the brief →'.

test_data.lead: Squilla is an open-source, Go-based content management system built around one idea: an AI agent should be able to build, populate, and operate an entire website with zero human intervention. Every operation is exposed as an MCP tool. Every feature lives in a sovereign gRPC extension. The kernel stays small, the system stays fast.
test_data.headline: The CMS where AI does the work.
